falseSynonyms.zh: 特點不等於好處 feature 只是特徵；某個特徵可能是優點，也可能不是。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A camera may have many features. Long battery life is one benefit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 結果不等於正面結果 result 可以是好或壞；benefit 必定指正面所得。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The result was unexpected. The benefit was lower operating cost.

falseSynonyms.zh: 影響不等於正面作用 effect 可以是正面、負面或中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The policy had several effects. One positive effect was higher attendance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 成本不等於好處 cost 是付出的代價，和 benefit 方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The cost was high, but the benefit was substantial.

falseSynonyms.zh: 風險不等於好處 risk 是潛在負面結果，不是益處。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The treatment has risks as well as benefits.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與名詞不同 beneficial 是形容詞；benefit 可作名詞或動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The exercise is beneficial. One benefit is better sleep.

falseSynonyms.zh: 受益者不等於好處 beneficiary 是得到好處的人或機構。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The community is the beneficiary. The new road provides the benefit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與名詞不同 advantageous 是形容詞；advantage 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The location is advantageous. Its main advantage is convenience.
